text: Adult patients attending Accident and Emergency (A&E) at or admitted to recruiting hospitals via a GP with a new diagnosis of AP established by two of the following three criteria: (1) typical continuous upper abdominal pain; (2) amylase and/or lipase three or more times the upper limit of normal; (3) characteristic findings on abdominal imaging (if undertaken urgently by CT or MRI)
sub_conditions: attending A&E at a recruiting hospital or admitted to a recruiting hospital via a GP
at least two of three: typical continuous upper abdominal pain; amylase and/or lipase >=3x upper limit of normal; characteristic findings on abdominal imaging (CT or MRI, if urgently undertaken)

text: Patients in whom trial treatment can be started within 36 hours of admission to hospital with a new diagnosis of acute pancreatitis allowing 120 min for preparation of trial medication
sub_conditions: trial treatment can be started within 36 hours of hospital admission with new diagnosis of acute pancreatitis
120 minutes allowed for preparation of trial medication

text: Patients from whom appropriate consent is obtained (from the patient or their legal representative).
sub_conditions: consent obtained from the patient or their legal representative

text: Age <18 or >85
Patients with a bodyweight over 200 kg
Known previous AP within the last 30 days or chronic pancreatitis
sub_conditions: known previous acute pancreatitis within the last 30 days
needed_info: history of acute pancreatitis with dates

text: Multiple sclerosis, systemic vasculitis, Guillain-Barré syndrome or other demyelinating disorder
Known epilepsy
Moderate to severe heart failure and/or coronary disease (NYHA III/IV)
sub_conditions: moderate to severe heart failure (NYHA III/IV)

text: Severe respiratory conditions including cystic fibrosis, severe asthma and severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
On home oxygen or home mechanical ventilation
Jaundice (serum bilirubin >50 µmol/L), and/or known advanced liver disease, on waiting list for liver transplantation or considered unsuitable for transplantation
sub_conditions: on waiting list for liver transplantation

text: Known cancer for which chemotherapy and/or radiotherapy ongoing/completed in last 6 months
Known haematological malignancy
Known end-stage cancer requiring palliative care
sub_conditions: known end-stage cancer requiring palliative care

text: Known established infection prior to or suspected infection, including COVID-19, at the time of AP onset
sub_conditions: known established infection prior to AP onset
suspected infection at time of AP onset

text: Known history of tuberculosis, or household contact with those with tuberculosis or opportunistic infection
sub_conditions: household contact with someone with tuberculosis
household contact with someone with opportunistic infection

text: Known history of infective hepatitis
Rare diseases or inborn errors of metabolism that significantly increase the risk of infections, including severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) and homozygous sickle cell disease
sub_conditions: rare diseases that significantly increase infection risk
inborn errors of metabolism that significantly increase infection risk

text: Known live vaccine or infectious agent within one month of admission
sub_conditions: live vaccine within one month of admission
infectious agent exposure/administration within one month of admission

text: Known immunosuppressive or biologic therapy within one month of admission
sub_conditions: immunosuppressive therapy within one month of admission
biologic therapy within one month of admission

text: Known hypersensitivity to infliximab or to inactive components of REMICADE® or to any murine proteins
sub_conditions: hypersensitivity to inactive components of REMICADE

text: Known pregnancy or lactation at admission
Females of childbearing potential who do not agree to use adequate contraception up to 6 months after infliximab infusion
sub_conditions: does not agree to use adequate contraception up to 6 months after infliximab infusion

text: Known participation in investigational medicinal product study within last three months.
sub_conditions: participation in an investigational medicinal product study within last three months
needed_info: clinical trial participation history with dates
